request.style: English, tender piano ballad, expressive female vocal, grand piano, string quartet, soft swelling pads, building from fragile to radiant, 68 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
Year after year we went up to Shiloh
Year after year I came home with empty arms
Peninnah's children running round the table
And every word she said cut deep and sharp
Elkanah asked me why my heart was heavy
Am I not more to you than ten sons

[Verse]
With tears I poured my prayer out at the doorpost of the LORD
My lips were moving but no sound came out
Eli watched my mouth and thought that I was drunk
No, my lord
I am a woman in deep distress
I have been pouring out my soul before the LORD

[Pre-Chorus]
Go in peace
And may the God of Israel grant what you have asked of him

[Chorus]
My heart exults in the LORD
In the LORD my horn is lifted high
No one is holy like the LORD
There is none besides you
And no rock like our God

[Verse]
The LORD remembered me and gave me a son
I named him Samuel, for I had asked
I asked the LORD for him
When he was weaned I brought him to the temple
To the very place I stood and wept and prayed
I prayed for this child
And the LORD has granted me what I asked of him

[Chorus]
My heart exults in the LORD
In the LORD my horn is lifted high
No one is holy like the LORD
There is none besides you
And no rock like our God

[Outro]
So now I give him to the LORD
